indications.description: Progressive, locally advanced or metastatic differentiated thyroid carcinoma refractory to radioactive iodine.

treatment.schedule_summary: Lenvatinib 24 mg once daily, continuously, until progression or unacceptable side effects. The clinician may prescribe a lower starting dose or later reductions.
treatment.duration_text: Continuous until progression or unacceptable toxicity

action.message: Severe renal impairment: source starting dose 14 mg once daily; consider current dose and dialysis separately.

action.message: Haemodialysis: 50% of the original dose may be considered. Specialist pharmacy selects dose; do not automatically combine with the <30 mL/min starting dose.

action.message: Child–Pugh C: source starting dose 14 mg once daily.

action.message: Withhold despite optimal BP therapy. Restart at reduced dose only when systolic ≤150 AND diastolic ≤95 mmHg AND stable antihypertensive dose for ≥48 hours, with consultant authorisation.

action.message: Urgent BP management review. Establish optimal therapy and need for interruption; uncontrolled hypertension is an exclusion.

action.message: Initiate or intensify antihypertensive therapy. Review any higher companion BP reading before continuing.

action.message: Restart criteria are not all established: systolic ≤150, diastolic ≤95 mmHg and stable antihypertensive dose for ≥48 hours.

action.message: After a hypertension interruption, consultant must confirm all recovery criteria and reduced dose; normal BP alone does not authorise restart.
